scope: C workspace only; no changes to production, original paper, datasets or sealed results

C1.selection: none; fixed recipe ablations, retain all results; B candidate selection remains B responsibility
C1.feedback: strict end_ms < query.start_ms; all prefixes share start-of-event pool

reference.aggregation: one event/rank/phase mean of log(base/actual); EWMA initialized at first mean

C1.residuals: save raw and corrected event/rank/phase mean residuals, within-event spread, cross-event drift and lag correlation by fixed period; descriptive only

C2.query_history: freeze at first of four query starts; exclude any historical event ending at/after that start; no feedback within query block
C2.features: local multirank feature_row, rank as log_rank; no metadata or peer; common training-fit pooled imputation/category encoding and event/rank-weighted scaling per group
C2.weighting: equal event mass; equal observed rank mass within event; equal cases within event/rank
C2.independent: two separate Linear(d,16,bias=True), SiLU, Linear(16,1,bias=True) networks; only own-rank rows enter each fit
C2.exact_parameter_count_per_pair: 32*d+66, confirmed by actual torch parameter enumeration

matched_groups.equalepochs: shared60 vs independent60; exact total params and per-parameter updates, different forward MACs
matched_groups.approx_forward_MAC: shared30 vs independent60; forward linear MAC ratio=(32*d+64)/(32*d+32); optimizer steps/parameter-update counts differ

C2.budget_caveat: No claim of identical function class, wall-clock budget, or simultaneous compute-and-update matching. Width, bias placement, shared supervision and activity composition remain different.
C2.selection: none; all predeclared variants, per seed and final-score ensemble; train-internal temporal extrapolation only

limitations: Existing exploratory train cohort; retrospective temporal diagnostics, not fresh prospective evidence
Old test explored and validation reused; neither consulted by this code
Metadata retrospective snapshot without historical archives; C2 does not use metadata
Sparse span-matched sampling also changes event composition
Three endpoints and four query events per endpoint offer limited independent evidence
